question: Does a typed subject-method-object boundary admit an exact finite knowledge update only with complete applicable evidence, and does a verified distinction change the next choice while preserving the declared correct candidate?
level: External bounded learning and task-admission calibration, not native free or a universal epistemology

triad.subject: Versioned point question, finite hypothesis universe, active subset, requested action and remaining fuel
triad.method: Pinned checker, fixed complete obligation set, exact arithmetic assumptions, update rule and resource caps
triad.object: Question-bound rational distinction receipt and its provenance
triad.interpretation: Neutral interface positions; not an intrinsic K/t/X assignment and not native AdvaDocumentV0

arithmetic: Finite point observations over exact dyadic rationals with at most 128-bit components; input/const/add/mul ASTs bounded by the existing checker
hypothesis_universe: Two declared candidate-value predictions, unit and dyadic-product, at the same point question; the correct candidate is supplied in this calibration, not discovered
knowledge_rule: H_new = {h in H_old | prediction(h) equals the verified exact observation}; require a nonempty result before committing
soundness_condition: If a correct candidate is in H_old and checker-approved observation equals its prediction, then it remains in H_new
strict_growth: NewConstraint only when H_new is a proper nonempty subset of H_old; repeated evidence may produce NoNewConstraint
free_candidate: TaskBoundarySatisfied allows only the declared external learn/checkpoint action; native_free remains Unimplemented and no global/open-world freedom is inferred
trials: Main: existing k27 exact distinction, active candidates 2 to 1, next choice changes away from unit
Repeat: recheck same witness with updated singleton; NoNewConstraint and no fuel reset
Fresh reuse: k30 instance with independently reconstructed receipt and same method
Exhaust all seven incomplete presence subsets of subject/method/object; no admission or state update

comparison: Three-presence-only gate versus complete obligation gate on the same fixed cases; candidate order before/after the checked knowledge update. No speedup, new hypothesis invention or native certificate claim.
validation: Reuse the pinned independent point checker; separately recompute candidate filtering with exact cross-multiplication and confirm sound-candidate preservation, no update on refusal, shared fuel accounting and serialized report consistency
costs: Retain construction, checking, filtering, serialization/replay and fresh-reuse costs where measured; process RSS and traced allocations separate; source authoring/network excluded, not zero
stop: One finite invocation, then preserve outcomes. At most one necessary implementation-repair replay, no native install, no automatic fuel reset and no new hard arithmetic search.

The exact learner does not promote f64 observations or report integrity hashes to native proof authority
